name: feature-forge-adapter-src-pi
description: Pi's hand-written adapter source. Not published; scripts/build-adapters.py reads ask-user-question/ and emits it into adapters/pi/extensions/. ask-user-question/ is a VENDORED third-party snapshot — see UPSTREAM.md before editing it. The 'verify' script is the contract scripts/validate.sh invokes for every adapter-src/<agent>/ dir. Note: 'test' passes an explicitly shell-expanded file list rather than a '**' pattern, because node --test only gained glob-pattern support in Node 21; on older runtimes a '**' pattern is taken as a literal path and fails with 'Could not find'. Requires Node >=22 regardless (pi-coding-agent's bundled undici needs webidl.util.markAsUncloneable).

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
